description: Maps deterministic change signals to the documentation surfaces that likely need review when the signal fires. Two consumer classes: (1) drift-event entries (match.source='audit.sh') consumed by scripts/doc_audit/helpers/handle_drift_events.py to auto-file [doc-audit] issues; (2) mission-end entries (match.source='mission-architecture-impact') consumed by /spec-kitty.specify and /spec-kitty.plan agents per CLAUDE.md to populate a mission's Architecture Impact section with the full set of likely-affected docs. v1.1 adds match.change_class and consumer_hint fields; existing v1.0 entries unchanged.

mappings.rationale: OpenClaw cron config drift implies service-inventory.json fields (timeout_seconds, delivery, schedule) may need updating. Class includes Felix self-modifications (see #273).
openclaw.json content hash changed. May reflect agent additions/removals, model assignments, channel routing, or credential changes. Manual review needed to determine which docs require updates.
Systemd user-scope enabled units changed (add/remove). Service inventory should record any new or removed user-scope services.

Systemd user-scope unit files or drop-ins changed. May reflect new services, new env-var injections (EnvironmentFile drop-ins), or PATH/identity overrides — all of which can be load-bearing for runtime behavior and warrant doc updates.
Homebrew packages on office2 changed. New packages may indicate a new tool or capability requiring inventory documentation; removed packages may indicate dependencies that should be deprecated.
Homebrew taps (non-default recipe repos) changed. Supply-chain surface change; should be reflected in service inventory or a dependency catalog.
Listening ports changed. New ports likely correspond to new services and need inventory + topology entries; removed ports indicate deprecations.
Systemd system-scope enabled services changed. Inventory should reflect any new or removed services.
System Python packages changed. May affect documented runtime dependencies for any Python-based service.
Docker images on office2 changed. Service inventory entries for containerized services (vikunja, etc.) should reflect current image tags.
System crontabs or /etc/cron.d contents changed. Scheduled work surfaces should be reflected in service inventory under the appropriate service entry.
SSH authorized_keys changed on office2. High-impact access surface; credential-manifest should reflect any new access grants or revocations.

A mission adds a new service or modifies an existing service entry. Update the JSON source first (authoritative per CLAUDE.md), then the narrative markdown and any dependency view diagrams. If the service represents a capability transition (e.g., new agent surface, new automation), bump felix-capability-roadmap.md status. INDEX.md is NOT listed here because service-inventory.md is already listed in INDEX.md; the lookup is transitive.

A mission introduces a new credential, adds a consumer to an existing credential, or changes a credential's scope. Update the JSON source (consumers list, scope, expiry). credentials-and-secrets.md narrative view and identity-model.md (if the credential reflects an identity boundary) need matching edits.

A mission adds a new data flow (producer→transport→consumer chain) or modifies an existing one. Update the JSON entry, the narrative .md, and the Mermaid .view.md so the diagrams reflect the new edge. If a new storage surface is introduced, also add an entry under the data-flows.md storage-locations table.

A mission opens or closes a network port, adds a host, changes connectivity (Tailscale ACL, DNS, proxy), or modifies a service binding. Update the JSON first, then the physical-topology narrative. For SSH/Tailscale ACL changes specifically: also update security-posture.md (SSH gates section) AND append to ADR-0004's ACL changes log AND review whether the phone-termius-setup runbook needs an update. Tier 1 change per CLAUDE.md change-control taxonomy — verification required.

A mission adds a new operational runbook under docs/runbooks/. The runbook itself is authored as a deliverable; this entry exists to remind the spec author that the new file MUST also be listed in docs/INDEX.md under the appropriate section AND that docs/DEVELOPER_PORTAL.md may need a navigation pointer if the runbook covers a new agent or capability that an onboarding agent would need to discover. Without this update the runbook is undiscoverable through canonical navigation.

A mission modifies an existing runbook in a way that changes its title, scope, or status (e.g., active→suspended). INDEX.md's entry for that runbook may need a title or annotation update. If only frontmatter (last_updated, last_validated) changed, no INDEX.md edit needed.

A mission introduces a new architecture document (design doc, ADR, spec under docs/design/architecture/). It must be listed in INDEX.md, possibly DEVELOPER_PORTAL.md (if it's foundational), and referenced from the architecture README.md if it describes a new subsystem.

A mission adds or modifies a systemd unit under scripts/office2/. The deployed unit is the artifact; service-inventory's `config_files`, `schedule`, and `dependencies` fields must reflect the new/changed unit. Pairs with mission-service-added-or-modified when the unit represents a new service. Triggers the rebaseline obligation (#557): the merge commit must record `Rebaseline: completed at <ts>` or `Rebaseline: not required — <reason>` per `docs/runbooks/security-baseline-ops.md`.

A mission modifies an agent prompt file under scripts/openclaw/agents/<slug>/ (AGENTS.md, IDENTITY.md, SOUL.md, TOOLS.md, USER.md). Service inventory's agent entry purpose/notes/depends_on fields may need updating; the openclaw-agent-setup runbook covers per-agent deploy expectations; the agent-prompt-sync-ops runbook covers the auto-deploy pipeline. No need to touch the helper itself; deployment is handled by the agent-prompt-sync service. Triggers the rebaseline obligation (#557): the merge commit must record `Rebaseline: completed at <ts>` or `Rebaseline: not required — <reason>` per `docs/runbooks/security-baseline-ops.md`.

The felix-core-digest signal-extraction loop tripped the sweeper_tick signal — felix-habit-sweeper either failed, raised per-habit errors, or hasn't fired within 26 hours. When the operator diagnoses the cause, the habits ops runbook and the felix-admin-habits agent prompt may need updating to capture the new failure pattern (added in #510 alongside the extractor itself).
New deploys/queued/<name>.yaml requires familiarity with the manifest schema and library API. Surfaced during specify/plan when the mission needs an office2 deploy.
Any new or modified office2 service should be planned against the discipline runbook and recorded in service-inventory.json.
Changes to scripts/deploy/lib/ affect every downstream deploy. Library API contract (kitty-specs/<slug>/contracts/deploy-library-api.md) should be reviewed.

A mission changes the calendar-clarification lifecycle — the validate → route_calendar_event → route_and_finalize → clarification sweep-finalize path, the 8h SWEEP_MAX_AGE window, the timing-only eligibility gate, the all-day fallback, or the calendar_all_day_fallback observability marker. The current-state explanation lives in docs/design/process-flows/calendar-clarification.md and MUST be updated so future missions read shipped behavior there instead of spelunking prior kitty-specs/ missions (the pain #780 hit). INDEX.md lists the process-flow doc, so it is transitively discoverable, but is named here because the process-flows group is new and easily missed. Seams: scripts/calendar_routing/validate_calendar_event.py, scripts/inbox/route_calendar_event.py, scripts/inbox/route_and_finalize.py, scripts/inbox/handle_clarification_state.py, scripts/inbox/clarification_sweep_finalize.py, scripts/openclaw/agents/felix-admin-capture/AGENTS.md.

A mission changes the felix-admin-capture inbox routing/finalize path (prescan → classify → route_and_finalize → mark processed, or the clarification/sweep steps in the capture AGENTS.md). The umbrella current-state explanation lives in docs/design/process-flows/inbox-routing.md and MUST be updated. Where the change touches the calendar-clarification sub-flow, also update docs/design/process-flows/calendar-clarification.md. Where it touches the someday or journal routes, update someday-flow-changed / journal-flow-changed too. Seams: scripts/inbox/prescan.py, scripts/inbox/classify_content.py, scripts/inbox/route_and_finalize.py, scripts/inbox/mark_processed.py, scripts/inbox/routing_log.py, scripts/openclaw/agents/felix-admin-capture/AGENTS.md.

A mission changes the someday routing flow — the route_someday creator (q:schedule + no-due-date task landed in Inbox), the reference-seam destination resolution, the fail-soft q:schedule label attach (felix-bot #715 403 boundary), the anti-silent-loss guarantee (#743), or the CREATE-endpoint-only rule (#524). The current-state explanation lives in docs/design/process-flows/someday.md and MUST be updated. Seams: scripts/inbox/route_someday.py, scripts/inbox/route_and_finalize.py (_adapt_someday/_adapt_vikunja_task), scripts/common/vikunja_refs.py, scripts/common/vikunja_refs.json.

A mission changes the journal routing flow — the route_journal_entry helper (dated atomic append into 08-Journal/, canonical frontmatter, registry path resolution), the _adapt_journal per-block sentinel + verify-before-append idempotency, or the JOURNAL_KEYWORDS classification. The current-state explanation lives in docs/design/process-flows/journal.md and MUST be updated. Seams: scripts/inbox/route_journal_entry.py, scripts/inbox/route_and_finalize.py (_adapt_journal), scripts/inbox/classify_content.py, scripts/vault/resolver.py + scripts/vault/paths.json (key 'journal').

A mission changes the habits completion lifecycle — morning check-in, record_completion (done=true POST echoing repeat_after/repeat_mode #524; three-write atomic; idempotent), the 48h auto-skip sweeper, the EOD-ET due_date write (#112) or its ET helper migration (#761), the schedule-load no-rearm ratchet (#608), reconcile, or the weekly-report ownership (#409). The current-state explanation lives in docs/design/process-flows/habits.md and MUST be updated. Seams: scripts/habits/record_completion.py, scripts/habits/sweeper.py, scripts/habits/set_due_dates.py, scripts/habits/schedule_loader.py, scripts/habits/reconcile_completions.py, scripts/habits/query_active_habits_weekly.py, scripts/habits/weekly_report_driver.py, scripts/openclaw/agents/felix-admin-habits/{AGENTS,SOUL,TOOLS}.md.
